records.rationale: Omit the protected-guest granule-size veto together with the memory-relinquish backend. Complete patch reviewed: relinquishing a guest page into a larger hypervisor ownership granule can release neighboring data, hence this is a real safety check. Current native driver makes no relinquish hypercall, and its ARM guest service probe rejects granules larger than PAGE_SIZE. No unsafe ACK intermediate is retained; future protected-guest support must include the proper granule checks.
